question: Who authored 'The White Tiger', winner of the 2008 Man Booker Prize?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravind Adiga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Aravind Adiga** is the author of the novel *The White Tiger*, which won the prestigious **Man Booker Prize in 2008**.
 
• The book provides a satirical and gripping account of India's class struggle through the journey of its protagonist, Balram Halwai.
 
• It was **Aravind Adiga's debut novel**, and he became the fourth Indian-born author to win the Man Booker Prize after Salman Rushdie, Arundhati Roy, and Kiran Desai.
 
• The novel explores themes such as poverty, corruption, globalization, and the socio-economic divide in India.
 
• Adiga's work was praised for its unique narrative style and its unflinching portrayal of the dark realities of modern India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rohinton Mistry:**
 
 
• He is an Indian-born Canadian writer known for his novels that often explore the lives of Parsis in India.
 
• His notable works include *Such a Long Journey*, *A Fine Balance*, and *Family Matters*.
 
• *A Fine Balance* was shortlisted for the Booker Prize in 1996 and is considered one of his most acclaimed works.
 
 
 
• **Arundhati Roy:**
 
 
• She is an Indian author and activist, famous for her debut novel *The God of Small Things*, which won the **Man Booker Prize in 1997**.
 
• The novel is a semi-autobiographical tale set in Kerala, exploring themes of family, caste, and forbidden love.
 
• Roy is also known for her activism and non-fiction works, including *Capitalism: A Ghost Story* and *Field Notes on Democracy*.
 
 
 
• **Vikram Seth:**
 
 
• He is an Indian novelist and poet, best known for his monumental work *A Suitable Boy*, one of the longest novels ever published in a single volume.
 
• His other notable works include *The Golden Gate* and *An Equal Music*.
 
• Seth is celebrated for his diverse storytelling abilities and mastery of various literary forms.
 
 
 
• **The Man Booker Prize:**
 
 
• It is one of the most prestigious literary awards, established in 1969 to recognize outstanding works of fiction written in English.
 
• Eligible authors must be from the Commonwealth, Ireland, or Zimbabwe (until 2014, when it was expanded to any English-language work).
 
• The award aims to celebrate the finest in contemporary fiction and has brought global attention to many authors.
